name: STINGRAY INVENTORY DESKTOP (Windows Installer)
summary: One-click Windows installer for Stingray Inventory with linked kit component stock updates, legacy-install migration, guided folder import, LAN access, and startup crash restart.
notes: Extract the zip and run: Install Inventory.cmd
Windows will prompt for Administrator approval (UAC).
Upgrades remove old app files and import existing inventory data before the new install is copied in.
Bundled branding is included unless you supply a custom logo at build time.
Installs as a SYSTEM startup task and restarts after crashes by default.
Settings can turn Auto run and crash restart off on test PCs.
Creates a Windows Firewall rule for TCP 8787 on Private/Public network profiles.

name: CARMI CLACKER (XIAO ESP32-C3)
summary: Clacker transmitter firmware using dual-trigger detonate send plus original RGB LED state logic: searching blue, connected green, fired red, then post-fired blue blink.
notes: Use Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a desktop or laptop.
Use a USB data cable and close any serial monitor before flashing.
Target device: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 clacker remote with TRIGGER pins on GPIO6 and GPIO7.

name: CARMI CLAYMORE (XIAO ESP32-C3)
summary: Claymore receiver firmware for Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 with mesh pairing, detonation command handling, and OLED/LED status indicators.
notes: Use Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a desktop or laptop.
Use a USB data cable and close any serial monitor before flashing.
Target device: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 running the Carmi-Claymore build.

name: AIRSOFT ENERGY INDICATOR (battery meter)
summary: Firmware for the Stingray airsoft energy indicator battery meter.
notes: Use Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a desktop or laptop.
Use a USB data cable, not a charge-only cable.
Close any serial monitor or IDE window before flashing.

name: STINGRAY CHRONOGRAPH - JOULES ONLY (XIAO ESP32-C3)
summary: Chronograph firmware for the XIAO ESP32-C3 with dual-gate shot timing, local AP web UI, raw joules energy display, velocity metrics, and printable report support.
notes: Use this version when you only want the standard joules calculation.
Use Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a desktop or laptop.
Use a USB data cable and close any serial monitor before flashing.
Target device: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 running the Stingray Chronograph build.

name: STINGRAY CHRONOGRAPH - EJE AIRSOFT CONVERSION (XIAO ESP32-C3)
summary: Chronograph firmware for the XIAO ESP32-C3 with dual-gate shot timing, local AP web UI, EJE airsoft energy conversion, and printable report support.
notes: Use this version when you want the airsoft BB energy equivalent conversion.
Use Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a desktop or laptop.
Use a USB data cable and close any serial monitor before flashing.
Target device: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 running the Stingray Chronograph build.
